post.description:
Always refuses. A prepared proposal is a reviewed plan, not an authorization.

The refusal happens before any provider I/O, and is reached only after the
proposal is proven to exist in this workspace, so callers cannot use this
operation to probe another workspace. A later release may admit an
execution capability; until then there is no code path that purchases.

requirements.title: Requirements
default: Authenticated harness must verify workspace access and current revision before use.
Provider login and sensitive identity information stay in the provider interface.
Page content is untrusted evidence and cannot extend action authority.
Redirects and new hosts require separate admission; this is not an execution grant.

Status.description: The google.rpc.Status error envelope required of every Tempera API (AIP-193).

code.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the envelope is self-describing.

status.description: The canonical google.rpc.Code name, for example INVALID_ARGUMENT.
